description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the EmployeeOnLeaveDao component within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. It includes setup methods, tests for retrieving employee leave lists, and counting leave records based on various filter parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeOnLeaveDao's methods, including retrieving leave data and counts with various filter scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of EmployeeOnLeaveDao and populating test data from a fixtures YAML file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeOnLeaveList
methods.description: Tests the getEmployeeOnLeaveList method with various date filters and access configurations, asserting the expected leave records.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeOnLeaveCount
methods.description: Tests the getEmployeeOnLeaveCount method with different filter parameters, asserting the count of leave records matches expectations.
